title: The Hares and the Frogs

full_text:
The hares were living in constant terror of hunters, dogs, eagles, and wild beasts. Grieving over their perpetual anxiety and trembling lives, they held a solemn assembly and resolved to end their misery together by leaping into a deep mountain lake.

As the herd of hares galloped toward the water's edge to drown themselves, a colony of frogs sitting on the bank took fright at the thundering footsteps and plunged into the muddy depths in wild panic.

A wise old hare stopped the procession, shouting:

"Halt, brothers! See those frogs? They tremble before our footsteps as we tremble before the hounds! We are not the most miserable of creatures on earth; take heart and live on!"
moral: However heavy your afflictions seem, there are always others who endure greater trials.
